title: pptx-deck deck spec
description: An ordered set of slide specs plus the deck-wide style tokens that make them read as one designed system. Slide-level packaging/doc_props are ignored when building a deck -- the deck's own win.

meta.description: Deck-level designer intent. meta.doc_props is stamped into the built package exactly as for a single slide.

slide.description: Canvas geometry every member slide must match exactly.

packaging.description: Same shape as spec.schema.json#/properties/packaging (validated against it in code). Applied once to the assembled deck.

tokens.description: The deck's design system, frozen by the designer. lint_deck.py enforces these across every member slide -- this is the measurable half of 'looks art-directed'.

palette_roles.description: Named brand colors (background, panel, text, accent...). Colors used by slides that appear nowhere in these values draw a warn.

type_scale.description: Keyed by element role. A textbox whose role matches a key must open with exactly this font/size (error otherwise).

margins_emu.description: Content margins for textboxes/tables (shapes and images may bleed by design).

max_elements_per_slide.description: Restraint budget. The forensic reference slide had exactly 7 top-level shapes; density beyond ~9 usually reads as clutter.

slides.description: Project-root-relative paths to member slide spec JSON files, in presentation order.
